jobs.title: HR Data Analyst
jobs.jd: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. Jabil, Inc. is seeking an HR Data Analyst to join our team. This role is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and reporting on HR data to support strategic decision-making and improve HR processes. Job Responsibilities:** * Collect, clean, and analyze HR data from various sources, including HRIS, ATS, and other HR systems. * Develop and maintain HR dashboards and reports to track key HR metrics (e.g., turnover, time-to-hire, diversity). * Identify trends and insights from HR data to provide actionable recommendations to HR leadership and business partners. * Support HR initiatives and projects by providing data analysis and reporting expertise. * Ensure data accuracy and integrity across all HR systems and reports. * Collaborate with IT and other departments to improve data collection and reporting capabilities. * Develop and deliver presentations on HR data insights to various stakeholders. * Maintain confidentiality of sensitive HR information. * All other tasks as assigned Job Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Analytics, Statistics, or a related field. * 2+ years of experience in HR data analysis or a similar analytical role. * Proficiency in HRIS systems (e.g., Workday, or similar) and advanced Excel skills. * Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is preferred. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. * Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and draw meaningful conclusions. * Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex data to non-technical audiences. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. * Understanding of HR processes and best practices. jobs.title: Innovation & Data Analytics, Associate – Liquidity & Financing
jobs.jd: About this role Your team The Innovation, Data & Analytics (IDA) team sits across Liquidity & Financing (L&F) within BlackRock Global Markets and Index Investments (BGM). BGM brings together Index Investments, Global Trading, ETF Markets, and Liquidity & Financing, which encompasses Securities Lending, Securities Financing, and Cash Management. IDA operates across L&F within the COO function and is focused on enabling the next generation of innovation and data-driven decision making. The team is leading the evolution of L&F's in-business data platform, driving AI adoption and citizen development, delivering centralized reporting and business intelligence capabilities, and exploring emerging technologies that can create meaningful business impact. Your role and impact We are seeking an Associate to join the IDA team in New York. This role provides an opportunity to work at the intersection of financial markets, data, analytics, and innovation, translating complex business challenges into scalable solutions. You will work across Securities Lending, Securities Financing, and Cash Management and collaborate with program and product managers, data engineers, trading professionals, client professionals, and other partners across the firm. Your work will help expand L&F's analytical capabilities, develop differentiated data and insights, modernize our data platform and tooling, and identify practical applications for AI and emerging technologies. Your responsibilities In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Innovation & Emerging Technology: Research, evaluate, document, and test new and emerging technologies, identifying opportunities to generate revenue, improve productivity and scale, and mitigate risk. Derived Data Strategy: Develop proprietary business data transformations and analytical logic through deep-dive research into trading, market, product, and client dynamics. Analytics & Business Intelligence: Partner within multidisciplinary teams to develop and expand analytics and business intelligence capabilities based on business impact and demand. Data Platform & Tooling: Contribute to the development and evolution of L&F's data platform and tooling, enabling scalable access to trusted data and supporting data-driven decision making. Partnerships & Collaboration: Build and expand data, analytics, and research partnerships with key stakeholders across L&F and the broader firm. Your experience Undergraduate or graduate degree in a quantitative field such as Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related discipline, with strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. 4+ years of relevant experience in data strategy, analytics, or technology innovation within financial services or a related setting; experience in Securities Lending, Securities Financing, Cash Management, or adjacent markets is preferred. Advanced proficiency in SQL and programming languages such as Python, with experience in data engineering workflows (ETL/ELT) and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Familiarity with APIs, distributed data systems, cloud and UNIX/Linux environments, Git, and modern development workflows such as Azure DevOps is preferred. Curiosity and demonstrated interest in AI, automation, and emerging technologies; experience with AI/ML/LLM techniques, agentic systems, or AI-enhanced coding is a plus. Exceptional problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex challenges into practical solutions while managing competing priorities with attention to detail. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to articulate findings, influence decisions, and drive alignment across diverse groups. For New York, NY Only the salary range for this position is USD$132,500.00 - USD$162,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance. Our benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com . We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn , Instagram , YouTube , X , and TikTok . jobs.title: Analytics Engagement Consultant
jobs.jd: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. Our people make all the difference in our success. Public Partnerships LLC supports individuals with disabilities or chronic illnesses and aging adults, to remain in their homes and communities and “self” direct their own long-term home care. Our role as the nation’s largest and most experienced Financial Management Service provider is to assist those eligible Medicaid recipients to choose and pay for their own support workers and services within their state-approved personalized budget. We are appointed by states and managed healthcare organizations to better serve more of their residents and members requiring long-term care and ensure the efficient use of taxpayer funded services. Our culture attracts and rewards people who are results-oriented and strive to exceed customer expectations. We desire motivated candidates who are excited to join our fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, and who want to make a difference in helping transform the lives of the consumers we serve. (learn more at www.pplfirst.com ). Duties & Responsibilities: Job Summary The Analytics Engagement Consultant supports data-driven decision-making across Public Partnerships LLC (PPL) by delivering analytical insights, developing reporting solutions, and partnering with business stakeholders to solve operational and strategic challenges. This role is ideal for an early-career analytics professional who demonstrates strong technical aptitude, business curiosity, and a desire to influence organizational outcomes through data. The Analytics Engagement C will contribute to analytics engagements, support data modeling and reporting initiatives, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve program performance across PPL's business lines. Key Responsibilities Analytics Delivery & Project Execution Support the execution of analytics initiatives under the guidance of senior analytics leaders. Perform data analysis, reporting, and research to address defined business questions and operational challenges. Assist in requirements gathering, project planning, and solution development for analytics engagements. Manage assigned deliverables and timelines while proactively communicating risks, dependencies, and obstacles. Contribute to the development of dashboards, reports, and analytical tools that support business decision-making. Data Analysis & Technical Development Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL queries, datasets, and reporting solutions. Utilize Python and related analytical tools to perform data manipulation, analysis, and automation activities. Support data transformation, validation, and quality assurance processes. Apply analytical techniques including segmentation, trend analysis, descriptive statistics, and anomaly detection to identify actionable insights. Document methodologies, assumptions, business rules, and technical processes to support knowledge sharing and audit readiness Stakeholder Partnership & Communication Collaborate with managers, senior managers, and cross-functional business partners to understand analytical needs and deliver meaningful insights. Translate technical findings into clear, concise recommendations for business audiences. Participate in stakeholder meetings and contribute to discussions regarding analytical approaches and business opportunities. Support the presentation of findings through written reports, dashboards, and verbal communications . Continuous Improvement & Professional Development Participate in code reviews, peer reviews, and knowledge-sharing activities. Develop an understanding of PPL's business operations, including Medicaid programs, self-directed services, payroll operations, program performance, and compliance requirements. Contribute to the continuous improvement of analytics standards, methodologies, and best practices. Stay current on emerging analytics technologies, tools, and industry trends. All other duties assigned Required Skills: Strong SQL skills with demonstrated ability to develop complex queries utilizing joins, common table expressions (CTEs), aggregations, and window functions. Working knowledge of Python for data analysis, data manipulation, and automation. Understanding of data modeling concepts, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently within established deadlines. Qualifications: Education/Experience: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field; equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. Two (2) to four (4) years of professional experience in analytics, business intelligence, data analysis, consulting, or a related field. Experience with modern data platforms and analytics technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. Experience working in healthcare, Medicaid, government programs, payroll operations, financial services, or other regulated industries. Familiarity with cloud-based data architectures and data transformation frameworks. Exposure to statistical analysis, predictive modeling, or data science methodologies. Experience supporting cross-functional business initiatives through analytics and reporting. Working Conditions: Remote. Supervisory Responsibility (If applicable): None Compensation: $98,000-$115,000 This role is eligible for a base salary within the posted range. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including skills, experience, and geographic location. Compensation may vary for positions based in high cost-of-labor markets. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive statement of all duties, responsibilities, or skills of personnel so classified PPL is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to celebrating diversity and intentionally creating a culture of inclusion. Our depth of knowledge and expertise allows us to bring the best of the big firms at a scale that works for our clients, with highly experienced bankers who truly invest in people’s success — today and tomorrow. While we are rooted in core financial products, we are differentiated by our approach. Our bankers are seasoned financial experts who possess deep experience across a multitude of industries. Equally important, they bring commitment — investing the time and resources to understand our clients’ immediate needs, identify market opportunities and meet long-term objectives. At Texas Capital, we do more than build business success. We build long-lasting relationships. jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.jd: Posting Date 11/12/2026 2000 16th Street, Denver, Colorado, 80202, United States of America DaVita is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and growth-minded Financial Analyst to join our National Hospital Services Group (HSG) FP&A team. This role reports to the Manager of FP&A and will support key recurring planning, forecasting, reporting, and business-performance processes for the HSG business. The Financial Analyst will build a strong foundation in monthly financial results, treatment-volume forecasting, revenue forecasting, operational reviews, and the annual budget process. This role offers meaningful exposure to HSG finance and operations leaders, with opportunities to contribute analyses and, over time, present findings to the Senior Director of Finance and other HSG leadership. The work of the HSG FP&A team supports decisions and reporting that reach broader Finance leadership, the Chief Operating Officer, and the Chief Financial Officer. The ideal candidate is a quick learner and a careful, curious problem solver who takes ownership of assigned deliverables, asks good questions, and is eager to develop into a trusted FP&A partner. The candidate should be comfortable working with large datasets and detailed models, and should enjoy collaborating with Finance and Operations teammates. *This is a hybrid role located in our Denver office. Tues, Wed, Thurs in office.* Essential Duties & Responsibilities Financial Reporting and Insights: Prepare monthly financial reporting and variance analyses, validate treatment-volume, revenue, operating-income, and run-rate drivers, and help translate results into concise commentary and presentation materials for HSG operating reviews. Forecasting and Modeling: Support recurring treatment-volume and revenue-per-treatment forecast models, including model roll-forward, Essbase refreshes, assumption updates, new and lost business updates, bridge analyses, and stakeholder summaries. Budgeting and Planning: Contribute to the annual budget process, including model and mapping updates, Anaplan data loads and maintenance, source-data validation, review cycles, and documentation. Business Partnership: Partner with HSG FP&A, Operations, field finance, Revenue Accounting, and other stakeholders to research data questions, explain performance drivers, and support recommendations to leadership. Process Execution and Improvement: Deliver assigned work within the monthly business-day calendar, flag dependencies and risks early, document recurring processes, and identify opportunities to improve model accuracy and efficiency. Technical Capability and Growth: Use Excel, Hyperion Essbase, Anaplan, Tableau, SharePoint, and other financial tools to produce accurate, decision-ready analysis, while building skills through feedback, review, and guidance from senior team members. Desired Qualifications 1+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, or a related analytical role, with a preference for healthcare or multi-site operations experience Exposure to forecasting, variance analysis, management reporting, or budgeting processes Proficient to advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, financial modeling, and working with large data files Experience with Hyperion Essbase and Anaplan is a plus; Tableau or comparable reporting-tool experience is helpful Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify drivers, validate outputs, and communicate clear conclusions Solid written communication and presentation skills Ability to manage multiple time-sensitive deliverables in a fast-paced environment, with strong accuracy and attention to detail Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field Strong alignment with DaVita’s Mission and Values What We’ll Provide: More than just pay, our DaVita Rewards package connects teammates to what matters most. Teammates are eligible to begin receiving benefits on the first day of the month following or coinciding with one month of continuous employment. Below are some of our benefit offerings. Comprehensive benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, paid time off, PTO cash out Support for you and your family: Family resources, EAP counseling sessions, access Headspace®, backup child and elder care, maternity/paternity leave and more Professional development programs: DaVita offers a variety of programs to help strong performers grow within their career and also offers on-demand virtual leadership and development courses through DaVita’s online training platform StarLearning. #LI-JS5 At DaVita, we strive to be a community first and a company second. We want all teammates to experience DaVita as "a place where I belong." Our goal is to embed belonging into everything we do in our Village, so that it becomes part of who we are. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and comply with state and federal affirmative action requirements. Individuals are recruited, hired, assigned and promoted without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. This position will be open for a minimum of three days. The Salary Range for the role is $57,784.00 - $85,000.00 per year. jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Snowflake, Databricks, SSRS
jobs.jd: Are you a dedicated Business Intelligent Analyst (Snowflake, Databricks, SSRS ) looking to build complex reports for our core Healthcare Education Team? About the role: As a BI Analyst you will be entrusted to support Trade and Commercial Reporting within Elsevier Healthcare Education’s (EHE) Business Intelligence Team. This role will partner with commercial, analytics, technology, and senior stakeholders to modernize reporting workflows, improve reporting quality, and deliver scalable BI solutions that support business decision-making. About the team- Elsevier’s Healthcare Education team develops digital learning, assessment, and simulation products—including Sherpath AI, ClinicalKey Student, Shadow Health, HESI, Complete Anatomy, and Osmosis—to support medical and nursing students, educators, and future healthcare professionals worldwide. From an AI Software Engineering perspective, the team’s work spans generative AI, RAG, intelligent search, personalized learning, data analytics, cloud-based applications, and virtual patient simulations to improve educational experiences and learning outcomes. Key Responsibilities Owning the development and enhancement of Trade and Commercial Reporting solutions across Snowflake, Tableau, and related BI environments. Applying AI tools, where appropriate, to improve analysis, documentation, workflow efficiency, and reporting development. Converting legacy manual reporting workflows, including Excel-based processes, into scalable dashboards, automated reporting, and repeatable analytical solutions. Supporting reporting migrations by translating legacy queries, business rules, and reporting logic into new data warehouse environments. Validating reporting outputs across legacy and new environments to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with business definitions. Partnering with commercial stakeholders, including senior and VP-level audiences, to gather requirements, clarify business questions, and deliver actionable reporting outputs. Investigating data discrepancies, perform quality checks, document issues, and coordinating resolution with business and technical partners. Maintaining documentation for reporting processes, data definitions, query logic, migration mappings, and technical workflows. Managing multiple reporting priorities and stakeholder requests with strong attention to detail and limited oversight. Required Qualifications 3+ years of hands-on SQL experience using Snowflake, Databricks, SSRS , or similar data platforms. 3+ years of experience developing dashboards and reports in BI visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms. Demonstrated experience converting manual or legacy reporting workflows into automated BI, dashboard, or reporting solutions. Demonstrated experience translating reporting logic, SQL queries, or business rules across systems, data warehouses, or reporting platforms. Experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders and converting them into technical specifications, reporting logic, or dashboard solutions. Proven ability to validate data, investigate discrepancies, and ensure reporting accuracy. Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and their applications. Elsevier employs 10,000 people worldwide, including over 2,500 technologists. We have supported the work of our research and health partners for more than 140 years. Growing from our roots in publishing, we offer knowledge and valuable analytics that help our users make breakthroughs and drive societal progress. U.S. National Base Pay Range: $71,600 - $119,400. Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates. Our people are at the ver y core of our success. jobs.jd: About Us Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Become part of a culture that celebrates your achievements and encourages your voice and ideas. Your next great opportunity for advancement is right at your fingertips! Take the initiative to explore your potential and embark on an exciting career journey with Johnson Controls. What you will do: The Analyst will play a vital role in analyzing and interpreting data to create and maintain the consensus forecast plan at multiple levels of aggregation, using statistical models, and leveraging insights from Product Management, Sales, and Marketing. The consensus forecast plan includes expected sales from JCI parts distribution centers to indirect and direct customers. This role is responsible to manage forecast plan of several hundred million dollars across multiple business units. How you will do it: Develop accurate and reliable forecast by utilizing statistical forecasting models, demand planning tools and market intelligence. Analyze historical sales data, seasonality, market trends to identify key factors influencing aftermarket demand and improve forecast accuracy. Monitor forecast accuracy, forecast bias and provide regular reports and analysis to stakeholders. Identify root causes of forecast errors and implement corrective actions. Continuously refine and improve forecasting methodologies. Establish and lead Demand review meetings to develop consensus forecast. Collaborate with cross functional teams, including sales, marketing, and product management to gather inputs and develop consensus forecast. Collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets. Identify patterns, correlations, and trends to extract meaningful insight for aftermarket parts planning. Partner with Analytics team to develop digital solutions that drive insight into major supply chain metrics such as Customer On-time delivery, Forecast accuracy and bias, fill loss analysis. Evaluate, compare and define gaps in forecast plan against top-down business objectives. Work closely with Inventory optimization analyst and Supply planning team to resolve complex demand/supply imbalance while improving customer OTD and optimizing inventory levels. Partner with Product Management to successfully transition parts, both end of life and new product introduction. Develop, maintain, and leverage Forecast performance metrics including forecast accuracy, forecast bias. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline forecasting and planning processes. Identify opportunities for automation and system enhancements to improve forecast accuracy and efficiency. What we look for: Bachelor’s degree in Supply chain, Statistics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or Mathematics. 5 years of proven experience in data analytics preferably within Supply chain and logistics. Proven experience in statistical analysis, data modelling and manipulation and predictive analytics. Willingness to travel both domestic and internationally (20-30%) to develop firsthand understanding of sites and the wider organizational challenges. Preferred: Advance Degree, MS and/or MBA Proficiency in using statistical and visualization tools such as Python, R, Power BI. APICS CPIM certification Proficiency in using supply planning software and advanced analytics tools. Experience in collaborating with multiple sites and business units to achieve business objectives. Strong verbal and written communication competencies Familiarity with the building technologies market. jobs.title: PGIM Real Estate – Analyst/Associate, Data Analytics & Governance
jobs.jd: Job Classification: Technology - Data Analytics & Management A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world. We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers! If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can! What you will do PGIM is seeking an Analyst or Associate, Data Analytics & Governance to join our Global Business Enablement team within Real Estate. This role supports two closely connected priorities: delivering trusted data products and analytics that inform decisions across the real estate investment lifecycle, and putting into practice the data governance that keeps that information accurate, well-defined and reusable. Working alongside other team members, business stakeholders, data stewards and Technology partners, the Analyst/Associate will document business requirements, trace data back to its sources, catalog and define data elements, and build, monitor and report on data quality rules. This is a hands-on role for an early-career professional who enjoys getting into the data, wants to understand how a global real estate investment business operates, and is excited to grow in a modern, AI-enabled data environment. This is a hybrid role (on-site 3 times a week) based in Newark, NJ or New York, NY. What you can expect Data Analytics · Participate in requirements gathering sessions with business stakeholders and document the questions, users, definitions, calculations and acceptance criteria for new data products and reports. · Trace the full data lineage for each new data product, mapping every required data element back to its source system, owner and transformations, and documenting gaps, overlaps and conflicting definitions. · Partner with Technology team members to build and maintain analytical datasets and reports using SQL, Power BI / Fabric and Excel, combining data from multiple internal and external sources. · Work directly with source data to validate assumptions, reconcile results across funds, systems and reports, and investigate variances and anomalies. · Support business testing and validation of new data products by preparing test cases, comparing outputs to source and historical data, and logging and tracking issues to resolution. · Help convert recurring ad-hoc requests into reusable datasets and self-service reports, reducing manual effort and one-off spreadsheet builds. · Prepare and normalize data sets for reporting. · Prepare user guides, data dictionaries and training materials that explain what each data product contains and the questions it can answer. · Support AI use cases across the team by documenting requirements, testing AI-generated outputs for accuracy and reasonableness. Data Governance · Catalog data elements in the firm's data catalog tool (e.g., Microsoft Purview), capturing business definitions, owners, source systems, classifications and lineage. · Maintain the business glossary to keep terminology, calculations and definitions consistent across teams and regions. · Partner with data stewards and subject-matter experts to establish data quality rules (e.g., completeness, validity, consistency, timeliness and accuracy) and encode them as automated, repeatable checks. · Monitor data quality and produce regular data quality metrics, scorecards and trend reporting for stakeholders and governance forums. · Perform root cause analysis of data quality issues, tracing them back to their source, and refer them to the appropriate data stewards for remediation; track issues through to resolution and confirm fixes are made at the source rather than in downstream reports. · Support governance processes, including change management for definitions and datasets, data access requests and the appropriate handling of sensitive data. What you will bring · Bachelor's degree in information systems, finance, economics, real estate, data/analytics or a related field. · 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis, data governance, data quality or reporting, ideally in commercial real estate, investment/asset management or financial services. · Working proficiency in SQL and advanced Excel; hands-on experience with Power BI or a similar BI tool (Microsoft Fabric a plus) and with semantic models. · Familiarity with data governance concepts, including data catalogs, business glossaries, data lineage, data quality rules and metrics, master data management; experience with Microsoft Purview, Ataccama or similar tools is a plus. · Ability to write clear, well-structured documentation, including business requirements, data definitions, lineage maps and test results. · Comfort working with large, imperfect datasets and reconciling data across multiple systems. · Strong attention to detail, with the instinct to dig into a number that looks wrong and the persistence to find out why. · Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both business and technical colleagues. · Genuine enthusiasm for AI and emerging technologies, demonstrated by hands-on use of current tools and ongoing self-directed learning. · Interest in commercial real estate and investment management; prior exposure is a plus. · A collaborative, curious and organized approach, with an eagerness to learn and grow. *PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. Note : Prudential is required by state specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations. The salary range for this role is from $90,000 to $130,000. Specific pricing for the role may vary within the above range based on many factors including geographic location, candidate experience, and skills. Roles may also be eligible for additional compensation and/or benefits. About PGIM Real Estate With $207.9 billion in gross assets under management and administration ($133.8 billion net),1 PGIM Real Estate provides investors and borrowers access to a range of real estate equity, real estate debt, agriculture, and impact solutions across the risk-return spectrum. PGIM Real Estate is a business of PGIM, the global asset management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. ( NYSE: PRU ). PGIM Real Estate’s risk management approach, execution capabilities and industry insights are backed by a 50-year legacy of investing in commercial real estate, a 140-year history of real estate financing,2 and the local experience of professionals in 32 cities globally. Through its investment, financing, asset management, and talent management approach, PGIM Real Estate engages in practices that strive to ignite positive environmental and social impact, while pursuing activities that seek to strengthen communities around the world. For more information visit pgimrealestate.com . What we offer you: Market competitive base salaries, with a yearly bonus potential at every level. Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO), and leave of absences, such as parental and military leave. 401(k) plan with company match (up to 4%). Company-funded pension plan. Wellness Programs including up to $1,600 a year for reimbursement of items purchased to support personal wellbeing needs. Work/Life Resources to help support topics such as parenting, housing, senior care, finances, pets, legal matter

jobs.title: Data Scientist 1
jobs.jd: Data Scientist 1 As our Data Scientist, you will act as an internal business consultant to help optimize every facet of this organization. You will solve problems and answer questions – using data – for other departments to help us reduce costs, reduce errors, and be a better organization for our 17 million members. Note: This is a hybrid role; the candidate must reside within a 100-mile radius of our Coppell TX office and be available to work on-site 3 days a week on a regular basis, as well as 2–3 times per month for team meetings and collaboration days. What You’ll Do Every day, you will help solve business problems presented to us by stakeholders using data. You will get a scenario or problem, such as, “We need to reduce cycle times,” and then pull, analyze, and interpret data relevant to that scenario. You will pull data from SQL databases. You will analyze and interpret data using Python, R, or other tools. You will determine patterns or trends and their statistical significance to the problem. To visualize the data, you will use Tableau. Once you have done your analysis, paired with a data engineer, you will present your findings to the stakeholder and confirm, refute or simply acknowledge a hypothesis. Your work may be implemented or may develop into something else. What You’ll Need To thrive in this role, you must have a solid foundation of statistics and data analysis. You must be able to describe a project where you pulled data, analyzed it, identified trends or patterns, determined significance, and delivered insights or recommendations to the business. What was your approach? What tools did you use and why? Did you get to the root cause of the issue? Did you confirm or refute a hypothesis? You must be able to speak to your involvement and decisions at each stage. For pulling data, we use SQL so you must be proficient with this tool. To curate and analyze data, we use a variety of languages and programs: Python, R, and even Excel. You can choose whatever tool helps you best, but you must be proficient in either Python or R. Excellent communication skills and an attitude of flexibility are a must. Very often, we get into the data and some aspect takes longer than we thought, or we have to pivot and change how we approach a problem. A dashboard works better than a model, perhaps. Then you have to explain to the stakeholder or the team why you made that change or why the deliverable is taking longer than expected. It’s all about being creative in your approach and communicating that frequently and clearly to people who may be less tech or data-savvy than you. You have worked previously with an Agile team or understand these concepts. You expect to participate in daily standup meetings, you’ll complete your projects or stories during our bimonthly sprints, and you’re ready to meet frequent deployment deadlines. #LI - SH1 Remarkable benefits: • Health coverage for medical, dental, vision • 401(K) saving plans with company match AND Pension • Tuition assistance • Floating holidays and PTO for community volunteer programs • Paid parental leave • Wellness programs • Employee discounts (membership, insurance, travel, entertainment, services and more!) jobs.title: Financial Analyst - Healthcare
jobs.jd: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. The Financial Analyst will support financial planning, analysis, and reporting for 3PL (Third Party Logistics), a business segment within CoverMyMeds. You’ll partner closely with Accounting, FP&A, operations leaders, and cost center owners to turn financial results into actionable insights, with particular focus on revenue, gross profit, operating expenses, forecasting, and the monthly close. What You'll Do Analyze financial performance and deliver timely, actionable insights that support business decisions. Develop and maintain Excel-based financial models, forecasts, budgets, long-range plans, and ad hoc analyses. Analyze revenue, gross profit, and operating expense performance against budget, forecast, prior periods, and strategic plans. Own monthly operating expense reporting for assigned categories and consolidate results across cost centers to explain total segment performance. Identify key financial drivers, risks, and opportunities and translate results into concise commentary for business leaders. Partner with cost center owners to understand spending trends, vendor commitments, contracts, and headcount-related costs and incorporate those drivers into forecasts. Support month-end close by reviewing financial results and helping identify accruals, reclassifications, corrections, and other accounting needs before close. Prepare variance explanations and supporting materials for post-close reviews with business leaders and cost center owners. Maintain financial controls and supporting documentation to help ensure accurate, timely, and reliable reporting. Collaborate with Accounting, operations, FSS, and Corporate and business-unit FP&A teams on financial analysis and planning. Lead ad hoc financial and planning projects by clarifying objectives, evaluating assumptions, and developing recommendations with limited supervision. Identify opportunities to make financial reporting, forecasting, reconciliation, and close processes faster and more reliable. Build repeatable reporting using Excel, Power BI, and enterprise planning and reporting systems. Apply AI and automation tools, including Copilot and Power Automate, to streamline recurring data pulls, reconciliations, analysis, and first-draft financial commentary. Cross-train across FP&A responsibilities and provide backup support to the broader team. Skills You’ll Need Bring 3+ years of experience in accounting, finance, financial analytics, FP&A, or a comparable discipline. Hold a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. Apply working knowledge of month-end close, journal entries, accruals, financial statements, and variance analysis. Build and maintain financial models and analyze large data sets with strong attention to accuracy and detail. Identify root causes behind financial results and translate complex data into clear recommendations. Explain financial performance effectively to both finance and non-finance audiences, including senior leaders. Manage multiple priorities and projects while meeting competing deadlines in a fast-paced monthly close environment. Demonstrate sound judgment and maintain appropriate confidentiality and controls when handling sensitive financial information. Build productive relationships across Finance, Accounting, operations, and other business functions. Take ownership of work, proactively investigate issues, and operate effectively with limited supervision. Preferred Skills Bring experience in corporate FP&A, management reporting, or a shared-services finance environment. Demonstrate experience in healthcare, healthcare IT, pharmacy, pharmaceutical, logistics, or distribution environments. Use large ERP and enterprise planning systems, such as SAP, alongside advanced Excel and Power BI capabilities. Apply automation and AI tools, such as Copilot or Power Automate, to improve recurring finance processes. Demonstrate experience with driver-based forecasting, annual budgeting, and long-range planning. Hold an MBA, CPA, or other relevant advanced finance or accounting credential. Demonstrate strong ethical judgment, relationship building, communication, teamwork, organization, planning, and problem-solving skills. Thrive in a collaborative, hands-on environment that values initiative, continuous improvement, and accountability. Location: Columbus, Ohio, Dallas/Ft. Worth. Texas We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. jobs.jd: Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. Job Details We are seeking a self-driven Finance associate with excellent communication and interpersonal skills to develop commercial offerings that address the complex landscape of the healthcare industry. As part of the commercial underwriting finance team, the candidate will develop essential financial modeling skills and learn to collaborate with the Sales, Legal, Sourcing, and Operations teams to forecast sales trends and profitability for national healthcare providers for across our segment customers. This associate will have a passion for creative problem solving and should be comfortable working both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This is a hybrid position reporting to either one of our corporate offices in Conshohocken, PA or Carrollton, TX in-person two days per week. Responsibilities Develop innovative customer pricing models, integrating an overall understanding of the customer goals with Cencora’s strategic vision Lead internal deal reviews with Finance and Sales leaders presenting the opportunity, deal structure, and profitability drivers (including all risks and opportunities) Liaise with cross-functional teams to gather customer-specific or deal-specific information Analyze customer purchasing trends to provide internal guidance on product pricing and margin initiatives Provide ongoing financial support for executed deals to drive margin and overall organizational goals Perform post-deal profitability reviews of recently signed customer accounts Generate ad hoc analysis reports as needed Perform related duties as assigned Education and Work Experience Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. 2+ years of experience in budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, financial modeling, management reporting, or a related field required. Skills and Work Experience Strong understanding of financial processes and systems; outstanding knowledge of data analysis, data mining tools including data warehouse applications, MS Access, MS Excel, and other query and reporting tools Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and orally Capable of building excellent cross-functional relationships, working across functional boundaries and at all levels of the organization Strong interpersonal skills Strong mathematical and analytical skills Strong organizational skills; attention to detail Ability to follow and interpret profit and loss statements Ability to implement processes resulting in satisfactory audit practices Knowledge of SmartView, Hyperion, Databricks, SAP BusinessObjects (BOBJ), SQL and/or Power BI preferred Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint What Cencora offers We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. We collaborate with multiple functions, including Finance, Claims, Operations, Marketing and Underwriting. As an AIG actuary, you will be challenged and encouraged to reach your greatest potential to help improve how we predict, manage and mitigate risk. How you will create an impact Your expertise in A&H risk management and pricing will be key in helping your team provide technical pricing guidance, product development analytics, performance measurement and financial reporting, while ensuring alignment with regulatory standards and corporate goals in support of the A&H business. Responsibilities include Support product innovation by collaborating with cross-functional teams to bring new products to market. Support any risk mitigation solutions to ensure alignment with corporate goals and regulatory standards. Help translate complex data into actionable insights for senior leadership, influencing strategic decisions related to budget, product design, portfolio management, and business segments. Assist team members, fostering a culture of collaboration and actuarial best practices. Independently and effectively engage with various internal and external stakeholders. We help our clients evaluate their risks and develop solutions tailored to their needs. We believe in empowering our employees to learn, grow, and make a difference. Our structure enables our teams to maintain their own unique, regional culture while leveraging support and resources from our corporate centers of excellence. HUB is a global insurance and employee benefits broker, providing a boundaryless array of business insurance, employee benefits, risk services, personal insurance, retirement, and private wealth management products and services. With over $5 billion in revenue and almost 20,000 employees in 700 offices throughout North America, HUB has grown substantially, in part due to our industry leading success in mergers and acquisitions. Position Summary The Pharmacy Analyst will serve as a core analytical resource within HUB’s national pharmacy analytics team, delivering data-driven analyses and reporting that drive pharmacy benefit consulting decisions across all markets. This position is responsible for executing sophisticated pharmacy analyses, producing actionable client-ready reports, and translating complex claims and utilization data into clear insights for Regional Pharmacy Directors and field teams. The successful candidate brings strong analytical instincts and pharmacy data expertise and thrives in a fast-paced environment where rigorous, timely analysis directly shapes the advice clients receive on their pharmacy benefit strategies. Key Responsibilities RFP Analytics & Financial Modeling Lead the financial and analytical evaluation of PBM proposals, turning vendor responses into clear, comparable insights for plan sponsors. Utilize financial models and cost projections to compare pricing structures, contract terms, and program options. Identify discrepancies, gaps, and terms that need vendor clarification, and make sure evaluations are consistent and defensible. Analyze pharmacy benefit data from multiple sources, including claims, utilization, clinical program, and market data, to uncover trends and savings opportunities. Support strategic recommendations by quantifying the financial impact of vendor, contract, and plan design decisions. RFP Process Management Coordinate RFP timelines across multiple PBM vendors per engagement, including distributing questionnaires, tracking responses, and managing finalist rounds. Evaluate vendor questionnaire responses using weighted scorecards and summarize strengths, gaps, and risks. Maintain the practice’s RFP activity tracking, including project volume, outcomes, and revenue by vendor, for internal reporting. Deliverables & Client Support Produce client-ready Excel workbooks and PowerPoint decks that follow HUB brand standards. Draft executive summaries that translate technical pricing analysis into clear recommendations for HR and finance audiences. Support consultants and account managers in finalist presentations, client meetings, and contract negotiation preparation. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, health administration, pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent experience. At least 2 years of experience in pharmacy analytics , gained at a PBM, health plan, benefits consultancy, pharmacy benefit coalition, or similar organization. Hands-on experience with pharmacy claims data, including NDC-level data, AWP, MAC, dispensing fees, days’ supply, and brand/generic/specialty classifications. Advanced Excel skills, including large datasets, pivot tables, lookups, scenario modeling, and formula auditing. Working knowledge of PBM pricing and contract terminology (AWP discounts, rebate guarantees, spread pricing, pass-through, MAC lists, specialty channel management). Strong attention to detail and data validation before outputs reach account teams Ability to manage several concurrent projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical findings to non-technical audiences. Preferred Qualifications Experience conducting or supporting PBM RFPs, market checks, or claims re-pricing. SQL, Alteryx, Python, R, Power BI, or Tableau experience for larger datasets. Familiarity with ERISA, PBM transparency legislation, and state PBM reform trends. Exposure to clinical programs (utilization management, formulary strategy, specialty management) and their financial impact. Core Competencies Analytical rigor • Accuracy under deadlines • Ownership and follow-through • strong verbal & written communication • Professional skepticism • Collaboration across regions •growth minded •team oriented JOIN OUR TEAM Do you believe in the power of innovation, collaboration, and transformation? Do you thrive in a supportive and client focused work environment? Are you looking for an opportunity to help build and drive change in a rapidly growing and evolving organization? When you join HUB International , you will be part of a community of learners and doers focused on our Core Values: entrepreneurship, teamwork, integrity, accountability, and service. HUB offers structured training, licensing support , and ongoing development opportunities designed to accelerate your career. Competitive pay with comprehensive health benefits, retirement savings matching, and company-paid life and disability plans Generous paid time off, paid parental leave and a wellbeing program designed to support real work/life balance A collaborative, high-performing culture with meaningful engagement, community impact through HUB Gives and genuine room to grow your career The HUB difference HUB International is one of North America’s largest insurance brokers, delivering risk management, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management solutions to businesses and individuals across the United States and Canada — through locally led teams backed by national expertise, giving you the agility of a local partner and the reach of a global organization. jobs.title: Strategic Finance Analyst
jobs.jd:
ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

 - A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

 - PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

 - Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.


JOB SUMMARY

Help us understand how PostHog grows, what that growth costs, and what we should plan for next. Working directly with our Finance team, you’ll own the day-to-day consolidated financial model, expense planning, and board reporting, with their guidance. You’ll explain differences between actual results and plans, partner with team leads on hiring and spending decisions, and ask thoughtful questions that challenge our assumptions.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Corporate planning and consolidation
   
   - Maintain the integrated three-statement forecast: income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow. Keep actuals, assumptions, and scenarios consistent and easy to follow.
   
   - Own the quarterly board pack and investor reporting. Report costs versus plan each month and explain what changed. Support fundraising analysis when needed.

 - Operating expenses and business partnering
   
   - Work with team leads to track hiring and vendor spending. Update the forecast each month and explain changes.
   
   - Set up monthly planning reviews so team leads can see their spending outlook and discuss changes.

 - Revenue and commercial analysis
   
   - Support Mine's revenue modeling, check inputs and calculations, document assumptions, and explain performance versus plan.
   
   - Run the weekly revenue update when Mine is out.

 - Example public issues/projects:
   The models and board materials are internal. These links provide public context for example projects.
   
   - Build a consolidated forecast and monthly reporting pack. Public context: Finance team https://posthog.com/teams/finance
   
   - Build a headcount and vendor-spend forecast that shows what changed each month and which decisions need review. Public context: Spending money https://posthog.com/handbook/people/spending-money
   
   - Build an infrastructure cost forecast and show how cost per product changes as usage grows. Public context: Pricing and usage-based products https://posthog.com/pricing




WHAT YOU WON'T BE DOING

❌ Sales Ops execution (deal desk, contracts, credits/refunds, commission calculations, policy implementation)

❌ Accounting close, revenue recognition, collections, and the GL

❌ Billing-system engineering or ownership of the data platform. The analyst uses and checks these teams' outputs for planning.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - Build and debug an integrated three-statement model in Excel or Google Sheets. Make assumptions explicit, add checks, and test scenarios.

 - Turn an unclear business question into a model. Separate facts from assumptions and explain which inputs drive the answer.

 - Reconcile model outputs to source data and investigate discrepancies. Keep forecasts and reporting accurate and up to date.

 - Explain why results differ from plan, get useful inputs from team leads, and follow up on missing information.

 - Ask questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and want to learn how a software business works.

 - AI is part of how you work. You use tools to build and check models, write SQL, and automate reporting, and you can show us examples of this.

 - Work in a small team where processes are still being built.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you - we're happy to accommodate! 

#LI-DNI

jobs.jd: Join The North Face Family The North Face was built on a love for the outdoors and the desire to enable all types of exploration, for all people, from their backyards to the Himalayas. Over the last 50 years we've lived by our “true north,” the belief that exploration has the power to change us, to challenge us and to help us see the world from new perspectives. To help ignite a global movement of outdoor exploration, love for the natural world and an unwavering commitment to protect it, we welcome and encourage new participants to the outdoors. We extend our reach through support of non-profit organizations, establishing programs that connect participants with close-to-home recreation opportunities, and creating a connection with young leaders, inspiring them to explore and conserve. As we enter our sixth decade, we pledge to: Empower exploration and the thrill of the unknown for as many people as possible. Protect the places where we live, play, and operate. Evolve the way we make our products by improving our environmental performance and social responsibility in the supply chain. The North Face: Analyst, Loyalty & CRM - Americas How You Will Make a Difference The Analyst of Loyalty & CRM is a key member of The North Face Americas Loyalty & Lifecycle team, responsible for the strategy, measurement, and optimization of analytics across XPLR Pass and Lifecycle Marketing channels, including Email, SMS, and Push. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing, this role analyzes customer behavior across loyalty and lifecycle marketing, identifies growth opportunities, and leads measurement and reporting across the program and marketing channels. Working cross-functionally across Loyalty & CRM, Marketing, Ecommerce, Retail, Finance, and Data & Analytics, this role helps improve how performance is measured, insights are communicated, and customer growth opportunities are prioritized. You will play a critical role in driving optimization efforts that deliver real revenue impact across the business and improve member acquisition, engagement and retention. What you will do: Loyalty & CRM Analytics Strategy & Execution: Build and lead the analytics roadmap for Loyalty and Lifecycle Marketing, prioritizing initiatives based on business impact, customer value, feasibility, and strategic objectives. Serve as the primary analytics voice representing loyalty and lifecycle marketing analytics, shaping decisions with objective insights and clear recommendations. Support the execution of omnichannel customer journeys across email, SMS, push notifications, direct mail, and emerging channels through customer data and insights. Partner with CDP, Analytics, and Technology teams to leverage customer data for analysis, audience insights, measurement, and personalization opportunities. Analyze member acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifetime value trends to identify opportunities for incremental growth. Develop forecasts, business cases, and opportunity sizing analyses to support investment decisions and prioritize growth initiatives. Evaluate audience strategies and customer segments to determine effectiveness and inform targeting approaches across lifecycle channels. Lifecycle Measurement & Experimentation Own measurement and performance management across Loyalty and Lifecycle Marketing, including KPI frameworks, dashboards, recurring reporting, executive readouts, and business reviews. Monitor performance trends across loyalty and lifecycle channels, delivering actionable insights into what is happening, why it is happening, and where to act. Establish and maintain KPIs, metric definitions, and measurement standards to ensure consistent reporting across teams and platforms. Lead experimentation strategy, including test design, governance, incrementality, uplift measurement, attribution, and performance evaluation. Quantify incremental revenue impact from lifecycle marketing and loyalty initiatives through testing, attribution, and advanced measurement methodologies. Analyze customer behavior across retail, eCommerce, loyalty, and marketing touch points to deliver a unified view of customer engagement and value. Operating Model Collaborate cross-functionally across the eCommerce team, VF data & analytics team, and marketing teams. Partner with Analytics, Data Engineering, and Technology teams to validate data quality, troubleshoot issues, and ensure accurate reporting. Adhere to a high standard for analytical quality, experimentation rigor, stakeholder engagement, and insight communication. Improve analytics efficiency and quality through automation, modern tools, and AI-enabled capabilities. How you will do it: Leverage analytics, behavioral, and customer data platforms (e.g., GA4, Quantum Metric, Consumer Data Platform- BlueConic, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) to develop a deep understanding of customer behavior and performance Experience using SQL to query, analyze, and validate customer and marketing data. Apply a structured approach to analysis—connecting data → insight → opportunity → recommended action Incorporate segment-level analysis into all work, ensuring recommendations consider how different audiences interact with our marketing channels or loyalty program Maintain strong data quality and consistency by ensuring accurate tracking, KPI definitions, and reporting standards What success looks like: Clear visibility into loyalty and lifecycle marketing performance, with actionable recommendations that drive continuous improvement. Present findings and data-informed recommendations to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership, translating complex analysis into clear business decisions. Consistent delivery of insights that influence business decisions and optimization efforts. High-quality, trusted reporting that enables fast, data-driven decision-making Positive feedback from cross-functional partners on clarity, quality, and usefulness of insights Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity As a purpose-led, performance driven company, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness, and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day. Skills for Success 4+ years in digital analytics, Loyalty analytics, Lifecycle marketing analytics, consumer data platforms, marketing analytics, or related fields Educational Position Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in business, statistics, analytics, mathematics or equivalent professional experience in a digital analytics role. What we expect you already know: Strong foundation in digital analytics tools (e.g., GA4, Tableau, Power BI, Quantum Metrics, Databricks) Strong foundation working with a Consumer Data Platform (e.g. Blueconic) Understanding of Loyalty and Lifecycle Marketing KPIs and metrics (Cost per acquisition, CLV, opens, unique clicks, CTR, CVR, etc.) Understanding of how loyalty program economy works (points, rewards, point liability, breakage, etc.) Experience analyzing customer behavior, journeys, and performance trends Ability to translate data into clear insights and structured outputs Highly proficient in Excel (or similar tools) and experience working with dashboards or reporting tools Basic understanding of customer segmentation concepts (e.g., lifecycle stages, cohort analysis, audience targeting) Experience with forecasting, opportunity sizing, statistical analysis, and measurement methodologies. Location requirement: Denver, Colorado What we will teach you : VF’s systems, tools, and reporting infrastructure· The North Face seasonal strategy and go-to-market calendar· All about our XPLR Pass loyalty program and lifecycle marketing strategy· Internal operating rhythms and cross-functional workflows VF Guiding Principles : Live with Integrity, Act Courageously, Be Curious, Act with Empathy, and Persevere. jobs.jd: WHO WE ARE Apex Fintech Solutions (Apex) powers innovation and the future of digital wealth management by building tech-forward solutions that help simplify, automate, and facilitate access to financial markets for all. Our robust suite of fintech software enables us to support clients such as Stash, Betterment, SoFi, Webull, and eToro, amongst many others; collectively, Apex powers access to the stock market for over 22+ million end customers. At Apex, we are changing how the securities industry operates by reinventing the status quo, which was manual, slow, and accessible only by the ultra-wealthy. We're digitizing and democratizing systems so that everyone has an opportunity to invest. When you're at Apex, you drive this change. You're part of a global team with a clear vision: to be the trusted technology that powers the digital economy. Our offices in Austin, Dallas, Chicago, New York, Portland, Belfast, and Manila are home to over 1,000 employees. Together, we’re shaping the future of financial innovation. Embrace change. Solve big. Win together. And be G.R.E.A.T. — grit, results, empathy, accountability, and teamwork — with Apex. We’re proud to be recognized for the innovative work we do, the purpose-driven nature of our work, and the collaborative culture we’ve created. Here are just a few of the many awards we’ve recently received: Best Places to Work 2026, 2025, 2024, 2023 - Presented by BuiltIn WealthTech of the Year 2025 - Presented by US FinTech Awards The World’s Top 250 Fintech Companies 2024 - Presented by CNBC ABOUT THIS ROLE Job Summary: The Financial Analyst is a pivotal role in our finance department, optimizing financial processes and systems to drive business performance. This position is responsible for examining financial data, identifying trends, and providing insights that guide strategic decisions. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, develop assumption-based financial models, and implement solutions that improve financial efficiency and accuracy. Key Responsibilities: Financial Modeling and Analysis: Develop complex financial models to support strategic initiatives, including budgeting, forecasting, and long-term planning. Analyze current and past financial data and performance to make recommendations on profit enhancement. Process Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in financial processes and develop solutions to enhance business operations and reporting accuracy. Implement best practices in financial systems and controls, ensuring compliance with regulations. Reporting and Data Visualization: Prepare detailed financial reports and dashboards for management, highlighting trends, forecasts, and financial performance. Enhance data collection procedures to include information that is relevant for conveying a succinct, comprehensive financial message. Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with management to prioritize business and information needs and translate business requirements into system requirements. Act as the liaison between finance, operations, and technology departments to enhance systems and interfaces. Project Management: Lead and participate in projects that enhance the capability of the finance function, managing timelines, scope, and project risks. Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or related field. 1-3 years of experience in financial analysis, business analysis, or a related field. Proven experience with financial modeling, budgeting, and expense management. Preferred Qualifications: Master's Degree in Finance or Business Administration. Experience leveraging AI tools (particularly Claude) for innovation, automation, and enhanced financial analysis Strong proficiency in financial software systems like Oracle NetSuite, SAP, or similar ERP systems. Advanced skills in MS Excel, including pivot tables, v-lookups, and macros Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Analytical Skills: Exceptional analytical and quantitative skills, with a strong attention to detail. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying complex information in an understandable manner. Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize competing tasks in a fast-paced environment. Leadership: Demonstrated leadership ability to drive projects and initiatives within cross-functional teams. Adaptability: Agility and flexibility to manage changing priorities and the capability to work under tight deadlines ​ Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. jobs.jd: Marketing Research Analyst As Marketing Research Analyst, in the eBusiness Department, you will be responsible in supporting the Marketing and Digital operations within the AAA organization, with a focus on digital member experience and service quality. You will provide and communicate insights with actionable recommendations, build actionable dashboards and reports, and work directly with stakeholders. This is a data driven role that requires a level of technical expertise to systematically find value in data. You will also work with many types of data and tools, including Voice of Customer (VoC) and customer satisfaction (CSAT) data, to spot trends and issues impacting our digital channels and provide actionable analysis and recommendations. You will be comfortable using AI to work faster and surface deeper insights. What You Will Do Provide actionable analytics reporting, analysis, and recommendations for various product lines. Develop and create analytics dashboards with tools such as Adobe Analytics, Tableau, and Excel Perform deep dives and segmentation analysis from various data sources and tools. Analyze VoC, CSAT, and survey data, along with digital behavior in tools such as Quantum Metric, to identify trends, friction points, and issues impacting our digital channels. Work with various teams including marketing, engineering, system reliability, big data, and product. Partner with system reliability, product, and engineering to validate issues with data, help triage potential bugs, and confirm fixes are working after release. Support enterprise outage and incident reviews by analyzing member impact and post-incident trends. Recommend and implement data driven solutions that provide measurable results. Provide insight and recommendations on website and mobile app optimizations based on member behavior. Track member-impacting issues through resolution using Jira and Confluence. Apply AI tools to summarize member feedback, detect themes, and automate recurring reporting, while validating outputs for accuracy. Manage multiple projects and deadlines. Strong experience as an online marketing analyst preferred. Experience using any Web-based analytics tools such as Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics. Tableau experience a plus Familiarity with Jira and Confluence for tracking member-impacting issues is a plus.
