jobs.jd: Job Description: About the Team: The Wall Street Journal is a global news organization that provides leading news, information, commentary and analysis. The Wall Street Journal engages readers across print, digital, mobile, social, podcast and video. Building on its heritage as the preeminent source of global business and financial news, the Journal includes coverage of U.S. & world news, politics, arts, culture, lifestyle, sports, and health. It holds 38 Pulitzer Prizes for outstanding journalism. The Wall Street Journal is published by Dow Jones, a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV). The WSJ Opinion section has long served as a forum for intelligent, values-driven commentary, dedicated to advocating a consistent philosophy that can be summed up as ‘free markets, free people.’ While we aim to persuade, every word we publish is the product of rigorous reporting, research and debate. WSJ Opinion offers sharp, original analysis and strong points of view on the news of the day. This position supports the Opinion section’s audience data and insights work. About the Role: The Wall Street Journal’s Opinion section is seeking an Audience Data Analyst based in New York to support our audience reporting and editorial performance tracking. Reporting directly to the Manager of Audience Data Analysis and Insights, you will be responsible for tracking audience trends, updating reporting dashboards, and translating audience behavior into clear takeaways for editorial leadership. You will assist in compiling recurring reports and ad-hoc analyses covering Opinion, Free Expression, Books and Arts in Review across web, mobile apps, newsletters, video, and podcasts. This is a hybrid role based in New York, with an expectation of working in the office three days per week. You Will: Extract, validate, and analyze reach, engagement, and subscription data from Snowflake using SQL to support editorial decision-making. Help build, update, and maintain dashboards and reporting views in Tableau. Support the Manager of Audience Data Analysis and Insights in compiling the recurring weekly analytics report and monthly performance summaries, with the expectation of taking ownership of these reporting processes. Monitor audience interaction, visitor loyalty, and how effectively content converts visitors into subscribers across articles, newsletters, video series, and podcasts. Utilize Adobe Analytics, Parse.ly, and native analytics tools from platforms such as YouTube Studio, TikTok Studio, and Meta Business Suite to pull performance data Assist with data quality assurance, reviewing query outputs and validating metrics between reporting dashboards and warehouse data sources. Contribute to code updates and documentation following team version control practices in GitHub. You Have: 1–4 years of professional experience in data analytics, digital analytics, or business intelligence, preferably in a media, publishing, or subscription environment. Proficiency in writing SQL queries to aggregate, filter, and join multi-table datasets. Experience developing and updating data visualizations and dashboards in Tableau. Knowledge of GitHub for basic version control and documentation. Experience working with audience, subscription, or editorial performance data preferred. Experience using AI-assisted productivity tools such as Claude or Glean preferred. Familiarity with Python or dbt preferred. Strong attention to detail, with a focus on data accuracy and proactive communication regarding task progress. An interest in news and opinion journalism, and an appreciation for the Opinion section's editorial standards and philosophy. jobs.jd: Who We Are: Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd:
About us:

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

 

Why we exist:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

 

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

 

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).



Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it  —  someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years. 

 

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Data Science team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

 - Growth Marketing 

 - Product Development

 - Strategic Partnerships 

 

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.



Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

 - No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc. 

 - No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals. 

 - Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end. 



What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

 - Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

 - Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

 - Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

 

Who You Are

 - First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" 

 - Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

 - Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

 

What You'll Bring

 - 2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

 - Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

 - Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

 - Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

 

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

 
 

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.



Please note: Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

About us:

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

 

Why we exist:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

 

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

 

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

 

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

 

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it  —  someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years. 

 

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Data Science team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

 - Growth Marketing 

 - Product Development

 - Strategic Partnerships 

 

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

 

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

 - No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc. 

 - No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals. 

 - Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end. 

 

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

 - Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

 - Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

 - Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

 

Who You Are

 - First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" 

 - Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

 - Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

 

What You'll Bring

 - 1+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

 - Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

 - Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

 - Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

 

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

 
 

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

jobs.jd:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be. 

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.



 - Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

 - Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.
   
   

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million https://eliseai.com/blog/intelligence-is-getting-cheaper-life-should-too funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.



About The Role 

EliseAI’s Product Solutions team are subject matter experts responsible for solving issues and answering questions for our customers. Our Product Solutions Analysts possess in-depth system knowledge on our individual client configurations and systems and configuration data access. The Product Solutions team works with other internal teams to troubleshoot customer issues and ensure the best possible customer experience.



Key Responsibilities

 - Provide tier 1 and tier 2 technical support to clients via Zendesk, our ticketing system, ensuring timely resolution of issues

 - Investigate, troubleshoot, and fix complex technical issues and escalate to appropriate internal teams when necessary

 - Maintain clear documentation and communication with clients throughout the support lifecycle, and approach each interaction with a customer-obsessed mindset

 - Collaborate with the other teams in Product Solutions to relay user feedback, identify recurring issues, run audits and contribute to product improvements

 - Maintain and update internal knowledge base articles, FAQs, and user guides to enhance self-service support options and reduce incoming ticket volume

 - Run Quality Assurance check on our Support AI Chatbot and provide ongoing coaching to ensure proper responses for issue resolution

 - Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team



Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff. We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.



Requirements

 - 1-2 years in a Customer Support Analyst or equivalent role is a plus 

 - Experience with support software and CRMs (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce, SQL Knowledge is a plus)

 - Demonstrated technical proficiency such as a computer science degree, bootcamp certificate, or previous work experience

 - Bias towards data-driven decision-making and analytical skills

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills 

 - Willingness to work in person at our office 5 days a week



Nice to haves include

 - Computer Science degree, bootcamp certificate, or equivalent

 - Experience building projects using low code / no code tools such as Retool

 - Advanced knowledge of Google Sheets or Excel

 - Familiarity with DataDog or other similar event-logging software

 - Familiarity with Postman or other API testing tools

 - Familiarity with Reporting tools such as Tableau

 - Experience writing SQL queries
   
   

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn! https://www.eliseai.com/blog/eliseai-raises-250m-series-e) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.



Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

 - Equity in the company

 - Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

 - Fully paid parental leave

 - Commuter benefits

 - 401k benefits

 - Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

 - A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

 - Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

 - We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!



Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $75,000 - $95,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors, including experience, skill level, location, and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Customer Data Analyst
jobs.jd:
ABOUT US

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Fieldguide is looking for a Customer Data Operations Analyst to help build and operationalize the data foundation that connects how customers use Fieldguide with how we measure, understand, and communicate the value they receive from the platform.

This role will sit at the intersection of Customer Success, Product, Data Science, and GTM Operations, translating real-world customer needs into scalable data models, trusted reporting, and actionable insights. The role will combine strong SQL and analytics capabilities with hands-on data modeling and reporting, ensuring customer data is accurate, accessible, and built to scale.

While this role will participate in select customer meetings, QBRs, and onsite engagements to understand reporting requirements firsthand, the majority of the role will be hands-on—developing and customizing reports, querying and validating data, building and maintaining data models, and addressing gaps in the underlying data infrastructure. You will then partner with Product and Data Science to ensure the right information is captured, structured, validated, and surfaced consistently.

The goal is to create a trusted customer data foundation that enables Fieldguide and its customers to answer critical questions around product adoption, engagement, efficiency, time savings, ROI, value realization, and business outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN


CUSTOMER DATA REPORTING & INSIGHTS

 - Own the development and customization of customer-facing reports and dashboards, translating customer requirements into accurate and actionable reporting.

 - Use SQL and existing data infrastructure to investigate customer questions, validate reported metrics, and resolve discrepancies.

 - Build scalable reporting solutions that can be reused across customers, service lines, and engagement types.

 - Partner with Customer Success to support data-driven QBRs, executive business reviews, renewals, and value realization conversations.

 - Identify where customer-specific reporting requests reveal broader gaps in Fieldguide's underlying data models or product reporting capabilities.

 - Work with Product and Data Science to move frequently requested reporting from manual/custom analysis toward standardized and productized capabilities


DATA MODELING & ANALYTICS

 - Develop and maintain scalable data models that support customer reporting, QBRs, value realization, and product analytics.

 - Write advanced SQL to extract, transform, validate, and analyze customer and product data across multiple data sources.

 - Build and maintain data models and transformations to create reliable, reusable downstream datasets.

 - Identify gaps in existing data models and address legacy data quality, modeling, and structural issues that impact reporting accuracy.

 - Translate recurring one-off reporting requirements into standardized, scalable data models and reporting infrastructure.

 - Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering to determine when customer reporting requirements should be addressed through analytics, data modeling, upstream product instrumentation, or broader infrastructure changes.

 - Establish reusable datasets and semantic definitions that enable consistent reporting across customers rather than recreating logic for individual accounts.

 - Reduce manual and one-off reporting by identifying opportunities for automation and standardized reporting.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role means Fieldguide has a trusted, scalable customer data foundation rather than relying on fragmented or one-off analysis.

 - Customer-facing metrics have clear definitions, sources, methodologies, and owners.

 - Customer teams can confidently use data in QBRs and executive conversations.

 - Product usage and customer outcomes can be connected to measurable value.

 - Data discrepancies are identified and addressed at their source.

 - Customer feedback systematically informs Product and Data priorities.

 - Recurring customer data requests become standardized and automated where possible.

 - Fieldguide can increasingly demonstrate defensible ROI and value realization.

 - Customer reporting becomes consistent across QBRs, renewals, and strategic engagements.

 - Product and Data teams have a clear understanding of the information customers need from Fieldguide.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Operations, Business Intelligence, Customer Analytics, or a related technical data role.

 - Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience querying, transforming, validating, and troubleshooting complex datasets.

 - Strong understanding of dimensional data modeling, data transformations, metric definitions, and analytics architecture.

 - Strong understanding of data quality, validation, governance, and operational workflows.

 - Ability to translate business and customer questions into structured data requirements.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large or complex datasets.

 - Experience creating dashboards, reports, and executive-level data narratives.

 - Excellent communication skills, particularly the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a B2B SaaS or enterprise software company.

 - Hands-on experience with dbt, including building, maintaining, testing, and documenting scalable data models.

 - Experience supporting Customer Success, QBRs, value realization, or customer analytics.

 - Familiarity with audit, advisory, accounting, or professional services workflows.

 - Experience working with product telemetry and customer usage data.

 - Experience partnering directly with Data Science or Analytics Engineering teams.



More about Fieldguide:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

 - Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

 - Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

Some of our benefits include:

 - Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

 - Flexible PTO

 - 401k

 - Wellness benefits

 - Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

 - Flexible work schedules

jobs.title: Investment Analytics Group Analyst
jobs.jd: At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One. Job Description Investment Analytics Group Analysts are a critical part of our team and serve a broad base of institutional clients. This role provides analysts with the opportunity to build a solid foundation for a meaningful and growth-oriented career within the firm. Analysts are results-driven and focused on meeting client needs, with responsibilities that include quantitative and qualitative analysis, financial modeling, due diligence, strategy research, presentations and reporting, data management, and client service. Process Automation & Improvement · Assess recurring finance activities and identify opportunities to eliminate manual steps and process risk. · Develop and maintain automated finance tools, workflows, and controls using Power BI, Power Automate, Power Query, Excel, and related platforms. · Translate business requirements into practical, scalable solutions and coordinate testing, documentation, implementation, and user adoption. · Monitor automated processes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve performance and reliability. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Preparedness
jobs.jd:
About the Team

The Preparedness team is an important part of the Safety Systems https://openai.com/safety/safety-systems org at OpenAI, and is guided by OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework https://openai.com/index/updating-our-preparedness-framework/.

Frontier AI models have the potential to benefit all of humanity, but also pose increasingly severe risks. To ensure that AI promotes positive change, the Preparedness team helps us prepare for the development of increasingly capable frontier AI models. This team is tasked with identifying, tracking, and preparing for catastrophic risks related to frontier AI models.

The mission of the Preparedness team is to:

 1. Closely monitor and predict the evolving capabilities of frontier AI systems, with an eye towards misuse risks whose impact could be catastrophic to our society

 2. Ensure we have concrete procedures, infrastructure and partnerships to mitigate these risks and to safely handle the development of powerful AI systems

Preparedness tightly connects capability assessment, evaluations, and internal red teaming, and mitigations for frontier models, as well as overall coordination on AGI preparedness. This is fast paced, exciting work that has far reaching importance for the company and for society.

 

About the Role

We’re hiring a Data Scientist to help build, evaluate, and continuously improve mitigations that prevent extreme harms from AI systems. This role is for an experienced, highly autonomous individual contributor who can take ambiguous problem statements, structure rigorous analyses, and translate findings into actionable product and policy changes.

This position goes beyond “running evals.” You’ll help create mitigation intelligence and monitoring systems that enable OpenAI to detect issues early, measure effectiveness over time, and reduce both over-blocking (unnecessary friction) and under-blocking (missed harm).





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Evaluate and improve mitigation systems, including classifiers and detection pipelines across domains (e.g., biosecurity, cybersecurity, and emerging risk areas).

 - Diagnose false positives and false negatives with deep error analysis, root cause investigation, and clear recommendations for mitigation adjustments.

 - Build monitoring and measurement frameworks to track mitigation effectiveness over time and across user segments and use cases.

 - Identify trends in over-blocking vs. under-blocking, quantify customer impact, and propose prioritized interventions.

 - Develop insights from customer feedback, complaints, and usage patterns to detect shifts in adversarial behavior and system failure modes.

 - Expand risk monitoring into new areas, including cybersecurity threats and model loss-of-control or sabotage scenarios, in partnership with domain experts.

 - Communicate results to technical and executive stakeholders with crisp narratives, decision-ready metrics, and clear tradeoffs.

You might thrive in this role if you are:

 - An autonomous operator: you can take a problem statement and independently structure the analysis end-to-end.

 - Strong at executive-ready communication: concise, clear, and outcome-oriented.

 - Skilled in turning analysis into productable changes: you’re comfortable influencing across functions to drive mitigation improvements.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience in data science or applied analytics in high-stakes domains (e.g., security, trust & safety, abuse prevention, fraud, platform integrity, or reliability).

 - Strong foundations in experimentation, causal thinking, and/or observational inference; ability to design robust measurement under imperfect data.

 - Fluency in SQL and Python (or equivalent) for analysis, modeling, and building monitoring workflows.

 - Experience building metrics, dashboards, and operational monitoring that meaningfully changes outcomes (not just reporting).

 - Track record of driving cross-functional impact with engineering, product, and research partners.

 - Cybersecurity data science experience (strong preference), including exposure to threat modeling, adversarial dynamics, abuse patterns, or security telemetry.

 - Experience with classifier evaluation, calibration, thresholding, and error analysis at scale.
   Familiarity with detection systems in adversarial settings (e.g., evasion, distribution shift, feedback loops).

 - Trust & Safety experience is helpful, but not required.

 - Genuine interest in AI safety, alignment, and catastrophic risk prevention.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Analyst, Partner Strategy
jobs.jd:
Cambio is a software platform that drives world-class real estate decarbonization. We help commercial real estate owners and tenants bring their real estate portfolios to net-zero using a machine learning-driven, end-to-end real estate sustainability platform. Our mission is to take the real estate industry into the climate action era.

As a Partner Strategy Analyst at Cambio, you will play a pivotal role in owning end-to-end data quality assurance for some of the world’s leading institutions who have chosen Cambio to manage their carbon accounting, benchmarking, reporting, and decarbonization efforts — including helping clients understand and act on building performance standards (BEPS) and other regulatory requirements. If you enjoy tackling quantitative problems, have a passion for climate-related work, and are excited about the idea of working at a fast-paced team at the forefront of climate, AI and real estate technology, this role is for you!



Key Responsibilities

 - Support onboarding for large institutional clients, assessing existing data sources and creating tailored onboarding plans.

 - Work with asset and property management teams to automate data collection and ensure smooth data ingestion.

 - Oversee end-to-end data quality assurance, transforming raw data into standardized, accurate inputs for Cambio’s platform and resolving issues with product and engineering teams.

 - Own all quantitative analytics delivered to customers, ensuring complete accuracy and high-quality outputs.

 - Build and maintain building-level energy, water, and carbon benchmarks (e.g., ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager) that give clients a clear, defensible view of asset performance relative to peers and regulatory thresholds.

 - Track jurisdiction-specific building benchmarking and Building Performance Standards (BEPS) requirements — such as NYC Local Law 97, DC BEPS, and BERDO — monitoring compliance deadlines and fine exposure, and translating pathway options into clear guidance for property and asset management teams.

 - Support enterprise sustainability reporting across frameworks like GRESB, TCFD, and CDP, ensuring benchmarking and compliance data flow accurately into every submission.

 - Manage building documentation collection and coordinate with building science teams to ensure successful analysis delivery.

 - Coordinate communication workflows and follow-ups for major customer accounts to ensure strong customer success.

Impact

With this role, you’ll have the opportunity to achieve the following accomplishments:

 1. Executed the measurement of real estate energy, water, waste, and carbon data across large asset portfolios, driving the identification of energy savings through Cambio’s decarbonization platform.

 2. Ensured the accuracy of carbon emissions data and developed new analytical methods to power the world’s leading AI-based retrofit analytics and real estate sustainability data platform.

 3. Collaborated with real estate owner customers to identify and remedy data inaccuracies, saving customers 100+ hours of time across asset & portfolio management teams and reducing data gaps by up to 25%.

 4. Built out jurisdiction-specific Building Performance Standards compliance pathways across client portfolios, giving an owners and property managers a single source of truth for benchmarking, fine exposure, and reporting deadlines across multiple regulatory jurisdictions.

Qualifications

 - Strong quantitative background: 2+ years of experience in a consulting, data analytics, accounting, or finance.

 - Data-obsessed: You are meticulous and thrive when surrounded by numbers. You are willing to roll up your sleeves to work with unstructured and inconsistent data using Excel. Experience with SQL or computer programming a bonus, but not required

 - Creative problem-solving: To you, an Excel model is an exciting puzzle to solve. You have the ability to think outside the box when addressing challenges

 - Strong communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. You are able to make complex problems seem simple and communicate these with multiple parties in dynamic, fast-moving environments

 - Collaborative team player: You prioritize the team's success and foster collaboration

 - Experience working with carbon or building data: Experience handling energy, carbon, or real estate data is a bonus, but not required

 - Understanding of building benchmarking & performance standards: Familiarity with energy/water benchmarking programs (e.g., ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager) and Building Performance Standards (BEPS) regulations such as NYC Local Law 97, DC BEPS, or BERDO — or a strong eagerness to build that expertise — is a significant plus
   
   

Logistics:

 - Work Authorization: Authorization to work in the United States or Canada is required.

 - Location: This is a hybrid role requiring 2–3 days of in-person collaboration per week.
   
    

If you thrive on creating well-crafted products and systems that have a disproportionate impact on the real estate industry’s path to net zero, we invite you to join our team. Apply now to embark on this journey with us.

The Warranty Analyst contributes by investigating warranty and goodwill claims, analyzing expense and repair trends, and reviewing vehicle buyback cases to identify and document the defective causal parts or conditions associated with repurchase. Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and motivated to turn complex information into actionable findings? At MSX International, we’re looking for a Warranty Analyst to support warranty group through data analysis, technical case review, and accurate documentation. You’ll evaluate warranty and goodwill performance, investigate unusual claim patterns, and collaborate with Quality Engineers and internal stakeholders to identify areas requiring further review. You’ll also support vehicle buyback analysis by reviewing repair histories and related records to identify and document the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions that led to vehicle repurchase under applicable lemon laws. This on-site, hourly role offers direct collaboration with warranty, quality, and engineering teams at the headquarters, providing exposure to automotive operations and opportunities for professional development. As a member of the warranty support team, you’ll: Analyze warranty expenses and prepare monthly comparisons against forecasts, prior-month results, and prior-year performance. Review powertrain warranty expenses, including coverage under HMA’s 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty. Analyze quarterly cost-per-unit trends by month in service, including failure rates, claim costs, and labor operation codes across warranty, goodwill, and campaign repairs. Identify significant cost variances, emerging concerns, and unusual claim patterns; communicate findings and recommend further investigation. Monitor goodwill expenses, support forecasting, and identify campaign-related costs and dealers with high expenses and low customer satisfaction results. Analyze warranty repair data alongside technician training records to identify potential relationships between training gaps and repeat repairs. Review dealer use of labor operation codes and warranty repairs, coordinating with Regional Warranty Managers when excessive or unusual activity requires investigation. Conduct repair-sequence and repair-narrative analyses to assess dealer repair efficiency and potential effects on vehicle quality. Review vehicle buyback repair records, service orders, and customer communications to identify the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions associated with repurchase. Collaborate with Quality Engineers and internal departments to clarify technical findings and accurately document buyback conclusions. Enter and maintain warranty, claim, and buyback findings in designated internal systems. Prepare reports, presentations, and ad hoc analyses for management. Participate in training and product-information exchanges; travel, including overnight stays, may be required for up to four weeks annually. Support occasional vehicle testing, service coordination, and other related assignments as directed. Technical Expertise Strong understanding of automotive repair procedures, diagnostic methods, and vehicle systems. Ability to interpret repair orders, warranty claims, service histories, and technical documentation. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Word. Ability to analyze warranty costs, failure rates, claim trends, and forecast variances. Strong data-entry accuracy and documentation practices. Desired Skills Strong analytical, mathematical, and root-cause investigation skills. Exceptional attention to detail when reviewing technical records and documenting findings. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain analytical findings clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Strong organization, prioritization, multitasking, and follow-up skills. Ability to collaborate with client personnel, dealership staff, engineers, and warranty teams. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a plus. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent. Experience in automotive repair and product quality. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data and develop clear findings and recommendations. Strong computer proficiency, including database querying and Microsoft Office applications. Ability to manage multiple assignments while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines. Preferred Qualifications Four-year degree in engineering. Dealership fixed operations and warranty experience. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement
jobs.jd:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail.

 - Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation.

 - Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions.

 - Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations.

 - Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans.

 - Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort.

 - Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products.

 - Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data.

 - Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled.

 - Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution.

 - Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners.

 - Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work.

jobs.title: Analyst, Applied Validations
jobs.jd:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Pilots don't train with real passengers. Actors don't rehearse with real audiences. Yet, the most consequential decisions in society are often pushed straight to production.



Simile is changing that. We have built the first AI simulation of society, populated by generative agents based on real humans. Our research pioneered the field of AI-based simulation, proving it is possible to model human behavior with high accuracy. Today, we are developing a Foundation Model to predict human behavior in any situation, at any scale.



We have raised $300M in total funding, with a $2B post-money valuation in our latest round. Our investors include Greenoaks, Index Ventures, Hanabi, A*, Bain Capital Ventures, Factory, CVS Health Ventures, and Definition.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Simile, accuracy is the product. Enterprise buyers want proof that Simile matches what their customers actually say and do, and as an Applied Validations Analyst, you will own that proof. You'll design and run customer validations and backtests that compare Simile's simulated results against real-world ground truth, then diagnose gaps, explain what the evidence supports, and identify opportunities to improve performance.



You'll work alongside Solutions Consultants and Deployments, and be deeply embedded with our Modeling, Evals, and Data teams. You'll turn one-off studies into repeatable, scalable workflows that build customer trust in a new category of AI. You'll identify patterns across customer validations and work with Modeling, Evals, Data, and Product to turn those findings into improvements, and test whether those improvements address the gaps.



This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys writing code, investigating data, and learning new methods while working at the pace of customer engagements.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Study Scoping: Scope validation and backtest studies with Solutions Consultants, Deployments, and customers. Pick the right use case, agree on metrics and success criteria up front, and flag studies that won't produce a meaningful comparison. Guide teams on which validation approaches are appropriate given current model and product capabilities.

 - Simulation & Comparison: Run simulations and compare them against human ground truth using industry standard evaluation metrics.

 - Diagnosing Misses: Break down gaps by segment and population to determine drivers of differences around methodology, model, data, or sampling. Identify recurring patterns across validations to distinguish isolated gaps from systematic gaps. 

 - Closing the Loop: Translate validation gaps into reproducible examples and concrete recommendations for Modeling, Evals, Data, and Product. Partner with these teams on follow-up experiments, evaluation coverage, and data, and retest whether changes address the gaps.

 - Reusable Tooling: Build Python pipelines, API-driven experiments, and LLM skills for repeatable validation loops. .

 - Customer Readouts: Write clear readouts showing where the model is strongly aligned and where it is more directional, and present them to technical and business stakeholders.
   
   


REQUIREMENTS


MUST HAVES

 - Statistics & Analytical Judgment: A solid foundation in statistics, including sampling, variability, correlation, and bias. You can question data quality, recognize misleading comparisons, investigate differences across populations and segments, and assess whether conclusions are supported by the evidence.

 - Learning & Iteration: Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar methods and tools quickly, investigate unexpected results, and improve an approach through structured experimentation. You are motivated to build expertise in customer validations and backtesting.

 - Technical & AI-Native Workflow: Ability to use Python and APIs to analyze data and run reproducible experiments, including using Claude Code, Codex, or similar coding agents to accelerate the work. You can review and validate the outputs these tools produce.

 - Communication & Commercial Judgment: You can turn analysis into a clear narrative, explain results and limitations to technical and business audiences, and connect findings to customer decisions and priorities.

 - Collaboration & Follow-Through: You can translate findings into actionable recommendations, work with Modeling, Evals, Data, and Product teams to address gaps, and document lessons that help others move faster.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Validation & Model Improvement: Experience running backtests and evaluating predictive models.

 - Evaluation Methods: Familiarity with holdout datasets, data leakage, and testing whether improvements generalize to unseen examples.

 - Human Study & Measurement Methods: Familiarity with survey & human study design, panel sampling, distributional comparisons such as TVD, choice-based methods, or differences between stated intent and observed behavior.

 - Research Background: Experience in behavioral research, market research, consumer insights, survey science, or a research-agency analytics team.

 - Survey Platforms: Experience with Qualtrics or similar survey platforms and panel providers.

 - Customer-Facing Technical Work: Experience in applied data science, technical consulting, or presenting analytical findings to customers.
   
   

Compensation & Benefits

At Simile, we provide competitive compensation packages that include base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

 - Salary Range: $200,000 – $300,000 USD
   
   - Note: Final offers are based on experience, specialized skills, interview performance, and relevant training.

 - Equity: Grants are available for eligible roles, subject to board approval.

 - Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Time Off: Flexible time off policies to support work-life balance.
   
   


OUR PROCESS

We prioritize thoughtful conversations and clear examples of past work. Our hiring journey is designed to help both sides align on fit, working style, and expectations.



Reapplication Policy: To ensure a fair and thorough evaluation for all applicants, Simi




COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

Equal Opportunity: Simile is an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities, valuing an environment where everyone can contribute authentically.



Accommodations: If you require support or reasonable accommodations during the application process due to a disability, please let us know. We are happy to assist.

jobs.title: Treasury Analyst
jobs.jd: King & Spalding is a leading global law firm with a commitment to excellence, innovation, and the seamless delivery of legal services. We harness innovative technology and exceptional talent to meet the complex needs of our clients in a fast-paced and dynamic legal landscape. The Treasury Analyst supports the firm’s global treasury operations by managing daily liquidity, cash reporting and forecasting, payment execution, bank account administration, and treasury controls. The role analyzes treasury data, supports banking and financial risk activities, and partners with Finance and other business teams to improve processes, strengthen controls, and provide timely, accurate information for decision-making. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Prepare daily cash positions, monitor liquidity across domestic and international accounts, and communicate cash balances and material activity to leadership. Prepare and execute electronic payments and cash transfers through approved banking platforms in accordance with authorization requirements and segregation-of-duties controls. Prepare short- and medium-term cash forecasts, analyze forecast-to-actual variances, and recommend improvements to forecast accuracy. Monitor excess operating cash and execute approved transfers or investment transactions consistent with firm policy. Support day-to-day relationships with domestic and global banking partners, coordinate service requests, and assist with bank fee and service reviews. Administer bank accounts and related documentation, including account openings and closings, authorized signatories, user access, and periodic access reviews. Administer the firm’s credit card programs and respond to internal and external inquiries. Prepare debt covenant calculations, compliance certificates, and related quarterly and annual reporting in accordance with credit agreements. Budget and forecast interest income and expense, analyze variances, and support treasury reporting and dashboards. Assist with letters of credit, rental guarantees, performance guarantees, and other banking instruments. Review and administer escrow and trust arrangements in accordance with firm policies, including related receipts, payments, records, and reconciliations. Support monitoring of foreign currency exposures and approved foreign exchange transactions, as applicable. Maintain treasury documentation and support internal and external audits, compliance reviews, and business continuity procedures. Participate in the annual insurance renewal process and coordinate requests for certificates of insurance and other insurance-related information. Support treasury systems and banking-platform administration, data integrity, testing, automation, and process-improvement initiatives. Maintain treasury policies and procedures, identify control or operational gaps, and recommend improvements that strengthen risk management and efficiency. Perform other treasury and finance responsibilities as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, or a related field. Three or more years of experience in treasury, banking, corporate finance, or a related area, preferably supporting multi-entity or global operations. Experience with cash positioning, payments, cash forecasting, bank account administration, and online banking platforms. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to analyze financial data, identify variances, and communicate conclusions clearly. Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, and written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and collaborate effectively across functions and regions. Experience in a global professional services organization. Familiarity with foreign exchange, investments, debt compliance, financial controls, and audit support. Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), or progress toward a relevant professional certification. The firm offers a generous total compensation package with bonuses and raises awarded in recognition of individual merit-based performance. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. DATA SCIENTIST (STARLINK) At SpaceX, we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for developing the strategy, key metrics, tools, software services, and processes for assessing how well key aspects of Starlink are scaling and how effective the Starlink Network is itself, in serving tens of millions of users around the globe. You will work with operators, subsystem responsible engineers, software engineers, and network engineers inside the Starlink organization as well as key contacts with various major external partners to help ensure the growth of this program. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd:
ABOUT SOLACE

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-02-10/vcs-give-solace-health-1-billion-valuation-for-patient-advocacy-tech?accessToken=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzb3VyY2UiOiJTdWJzY3JpYmVyR2lmdGVkQXJ0aWNsZSIsImlhdCI6MTc3MDczMDg4MywiZXhwIjoxNzcxMzM1NjgzLCJhcnRpY2xlSWQiOiJUQThVUzhLR0NURzEwMCIsImJjb25uZWN0SWQiOiJBRDYxODI0MTc0ODM0MTk0QTRENUZFNzkwMzNGMDJGNSJ9.TE2pFUAOQAPMUXFlzoQ7zeJvctq7cSibbZqtIwhW-2U&leadSource=uverify+wall.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Solace, data isn't just about understanding the past; it's about predicting the future. We are a rapidly scaling startup where we work hard, move fast, and wear many hats.

The Solace Data Team is looking for a Data Scientist who excels at forecasting, prediction, and machine learning to help us anticipate patient needs and optimize our operations. Reporting directly to the VP of Data, you will have the opportunity to lead high-impact projects that directly influence our strategic decision-making.

In this role, you will go beyond descriptive analytics to build the predictive engines that drive our business. Whether you are forecasting operational volume, modeling patient risk, or designing rigorous A/B tests, you will bridge the gap between advanced statistics and practical business application, ensuring our models are robust, interpretable, and impactful.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build Predictive Models: Develop and refine machine learning models to solve critical business problems, such as predicting patient churn, estimating operational volume, or scoring advocate quality.

 - Drive Forecasting Rigor: Own the development of time-series forecasts that guide our capacity planning and resource allocation. You will help us anticipate "what comes next" with higher accuracy.

 - Design & Analyze Experiments: Lead the design and analysis of A/B tests and causal inference studies. You will ensure we measure the true impact of our product and operational changes.

 - Uncover Deep Insights: Apply advanced statistical methods to complex datasets to find patterns that simple reporting might miss. You will answer the "why" and "how" behind our most difficult questions.

 - Productionize Solutions: Work closely with Data Engineers to take your models from a local notebook to a production environment, ensuring they run reliably within our data infrastructure.

 - Communicate Complexity: Translate complex statistical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders. You will be the voice of statistical reason in strategic discussions.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Statistical Expertise: You have a strong background in statistics, probability, and mathematics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time-series forecasting).

 - Python & ML Proficiency: You are fluent in Python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, NumPy). You write clean, reproducible code.

 - Forecasting Experience: You have hands-on experience with time-series analysis and forecasting techniques (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing).

 - Advanced SQL: You can write complex queries to wrangle your own data from Snowflake without relying solely on others to prepare it for you.

 - Preferred Masters Degree or PHD: Data Science, Applied Science, or related fields.

 - Data Privacy Awareness: You understand the importance of protecting patient data. You are familiar with best practices for handling PHI and PII and ensuring privacy in your analysis.

 - Startup DNA: You are a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity. You take ownership of problems and are willing to wear many hats to get the job done.


BONUS POINTS

 - Deployment Experience: Experience using tools like Docker, Airflow, or MLflow to deploy and monitor models in production.

 - Healthcare Experience: Experience working with healthcare or insurance claims data is a plus.

 - NLP & Unstructured Data: Experience applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to extract insights from unstructured text data.

 - Marketplace Matching: Experience designing matching algorithms or ranking systems for two-sided marketplaces.

 - dbt & Engineering Skills: Comfort reading or writing dbt models to understand the lineage of your data.

Applicants must be based in the United States.



Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com http://ashbyhq.com. Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd: Data Scientist Build AI That Accelerates Scientific Discovery Do you want your work to help researchers solve humanity’s biggest challenges? At Elsevier, data science is not about building models for the sake of building models. It is about advancing scientific discovery, improving healthcare outcomes, and helping researchers, clinicians, educators, and institutions unlock knowledge that can improve lives around the world. Every day, millions of scientists rely on our products to discover evidence, connect ideas, validate findings, and advance research. As a Data Scientist, your work will directly contribute to the tools and technologies that help accelerate human progress. About the Team As part of a growing team of Data Scientists, you will take on some of the hardest problems in science. This team is building intelligent systems that can reason across scientific publications, research data, knowledge graphs, ontologies, metadata, taxonomies, citations, and content spanning every scientific discipline. About the Role As a Data Scientist at Elsevier, you will design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions that power knowledge discovery across the global research ecosystem. You will work with one of the world's richest collections of scientific information, including publications, citations, research datasets, metadata, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and multidisciplinary content spanning every scientific field. This role combines cutting-edge AI with meaningful impact. You will help build intelligent systems that make scientific knowledge more discoverable, trustworthy, connected, and actionable. What You'll Do Design and deploy machine learning, NLP, and generative AI solutions that help researchers discover, understand, and apply scientific knowledge. Build intelligent retrieval, search, recommendation, ranking, and question-answering systems that improve research outcomes. Develop AI systems that connect information across publications, datasets, citations, knowledge graphs, and scientific ontologies. Fine-tune, evaluate, and integrate large language models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems into production environments. Create robust evaluation frameworks that measure quality, reliability, relevance, trustworthiness, and user impact. Build scalable data pipelines and machine learning workflows that support experimentation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Apply the appropriate combination of classical machine learning, deep learning, retrieval, and generative AI techniques to solve complex scientific problems. Collaborate with engineering, product, UX, analytics, and domain experts to transform ambiguous challenges into practical solutions. Contribute clean, maintainable, production-quality Python code and reusable AI components. Continuously improve the capabilities, performance, and real-world value of AI systems that support scientific discovery. What We're Looking For Degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline. Extensive Python programming skills and experience building production-quality data science solutions. Experience with machine learning fundamentals, including model development, evaluation, feature engineering, and performance optimization. Experience working with large-scale structured, semi-structured, or unstructured datasets. Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, including large language models, embeddings, retrieval systems, and generative AI. Familiarity with frameworks such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent tools. Experience evaluating AI outputs and improving model quality, reliability, and business impact. Ability to translate complex problems into measurable, data-driven solutions. A genuine passion for advancing science, improving access to knowledge, and using AI to create meaningful real-world impact. Why Join Elsevier Because your work will matter. You will help build AI systems that support researchers, healthcare professionals, educators, and institutions around the world. Your contributions will help people discover critical evidence, uncover new insights, accelerate innovation, and advance scientific progress. This is an opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and meaningful AI problems anywhere—combining world-class data, cutting-edge technology, and a mission dedicated to improving lives through science and knowledge. jobs.jd: DB E.C.O. North America (with “E.C.O.” representing “ E ngineering, C onsulting and O perations") offers specialized rail and transit consultancy services to public agencies, passenger and freight railroads. DB E.C.O. North America is part of the DB E.C.O. Group and leverages Deutsche Bahn’s global expertise to advance mobility and rail transportation across the U.S. and Canada. Their cross-disciplinary team collaborates closely with clients to innovate their portfolios and elevate business performance. With a focus on sustainability, safety, and operational excellence, they strive to enhance the customer experience, increase rail usage, and “Transform The Future Of Mobility.” Departmen t: Consulting, Rail Operations Reports to: Principal Location: New York City, or Washington, D.C. o r Sacramento, CA (In-person) The Financial Analyst will support economic, financial, and business analyses across transportation, rail, transit, and infrastructure projects. The position is not assigned to a single client or program and may support multiple projects as well as internal business needs. The role contributes to cost estimating, financial planning, affordability assessments, business case development, funding analyses, and strategic recommendations for public- and private-sector clients. The position requires strong analytical capabilities, proficiency in financial modeling and data analysis, and the ability to translate complex findings into clear, practical recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. The analyst will work independently and as part of multidisciplinary project teams in a consulting environment where assignments, clients, and priorities may vary over time. Tasks and Responsibilities: Support economic, financial, and business case analyses for transportation, rail, transit, and infrastructure projects. Develop and maintain cost estimates, financial models, forecasts, affordability assessments, and scenario analyses. Conduct life-cycle cost, sensitivity, risk, and investment analyses to support project and management decisions. Collect, validate, clean, and analyze financial, operational, market, and project-related data from diverse sources. Perform quality checks on models, calculations, assumptions, and source data to support reliable and defensible analysis. Prepare analytical inputs for grant applications, funding proposals, financing strategies, and investment plans. Conduct market research, benchmarking, and comparative analyses relevant to transportation and infrastructure programs. Create tables, charts, dashboards, visualizations and associated descriptive text to communicate analytical results clearly. Contribute to reports, presentations, business cases, proposals, and briefings for clients and internal stakeholders. Support project financial monitoring, including budgets, forecasts, variances, and management reporting, as required. Support internal commercial analyses, including project budgets, fee estimates, utilization, profitability considerations, and related management reporting, as required. Develop and improve analytical tools, models, templates, databases, and methodologies. Document assumptions, data sources, methodologies, limitations, and recommendations in a clear and traceable manner. Collaborate with internal teams and client stakeholders. Manage assigned analyses independently, prioritize competing tasks, and deliver high-quality work within agreed schedules. Requirements: Masters degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field or Bachelor's degree with 3+ years of relevant professional experience or graduate degree. Demonstrated quantitative, analytical, and data modeling skills through professional experience and/or academic coursework. Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modeling, data analysis, and structured documentation of assumptions. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint and Word. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analytical findings to varied audiences. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple assignments. Self-directed, dependable, and able to work independently with limited supervision while contributing effectively to a team. Preferred skills and experience: Cost estimating, financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, or business case development. Public transportation, rail, transit, infrastructure, engineering, or management consulting. Public-sector projects, transportation agencies, infrastructure owners, or public funding programs. Procurement, pricing, grants, funding, financing, or commercial analysis. Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, R, and/or other data analytics and visualization tools. Working with multidisciplinary teams and preparing client-facing deliverables. Working Conditions and Travel : Minimal overnight travel by land and air. jobs.jd: Job Classification: Corporate - Legal and Compliance At Prudential, talent drives our vision. Join us to build an impactful career, grow your skills, and advance your profession at one of the world’s leading financial services institutions. PGIM Credit, a division of PGIM Inc., an SEC-registered investment adviser and a business unit of Prudential Financial, Inc., is seeking a Compliance Analyst. With over $1 trillion in assets under management across fixed income and private credit strategies, PGIM Credit serves sub-advised mutual funds, CLOs, public retirement funds, Taft-Hartley plans, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, and other commingled and separate client accounts. As a Compliance Analyst, you’ll take ownership of trade-surveillance investigations and provide proactive compliance guidance for the Fixed Income Trading and Securities Lending, Special Situations (workouts), and Asset Backed Financing investment teams. You’ll combine data analysis, fixed income trading knowledge, and sound judgment to assess activity, reach well-supported conclusions, and identify concerns requiring escalation. Working closely with Portfolio Management, Operations, and Portfolio Analytics, you’ll gather context, ask thoughtful questions, and prepare analysis that informs senior Fixed Income leadership discussions. This collaborative, fast-paced role offers the opportunity to strengthen surveillance practices as business needs and regulatory expectations evolve. This role is based in our office in Newark, NJ. Our organization follows a hybrid work structure where employees can work remotely and from the office, as needed, based on demands of specific tasks or personal work preferences. This position is hybrid and requires your on-site presence on a reoccurring weekly basis at least 3 days per week. What you can expect: Support trade-surveillance investigations. Review alerts, exceptions, and outliers; investigate potentially concerning activity; and establish the circumstances behind flagged transactions. Partner with investment and operational teams. Engage Portfolio Management, Operations, and Portfolio Analytics to gather information and clarify trading decisions. Conduct substantive compliance analysis. Evaluate fair and equitable trade allocations, best execution, trading conflicts, front running, and cherry picking. Interpret surveillance results in the trading context, reach conclusions, and escalate concerns as appropriate. Prepare analysis for senior Fixed Income leadership . Produce reporting on significant findings and trends for senior leadership. Provide proactive compliance guidance. Review trade amendments, reallocations, and other matters raised by Operations and Portfolio Management; provide guidance or compliance approval, as appropriate. Advise on information barriers and regulatory matters. Strengthen surveillance through data and technology . Help manage, develop, and modernize the program. Partner with Technology to understand intended functionality, review outputs, and validate results against trading and compliance expectations. Maintain clear, defensible records. Document investigative steps, supporting evidence, assessments, escalations, and closures. Support broader compliance programs. Oversee proxy voting compliance programs and maintain policies and procedures that support evolving business needs and compliance objectives. What you’ll need: 3+ years of compliance experience covering fixed income, with knowledge of fixed income trading strategies. Experience working with trading systems is required; Aladdin experience is strongly preferred. Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and Tableau, with the ability to interpret data and draw actionable conclusions. Sound judgment and an understanding of business risks, the marketplace, and the regulatory environment. Confidence engaging investment professionals and business partners: ask probing questions, respectfully challenge explanations, and communicate compliance guidance clearly and constructively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex analysis into clear reporting for senior stakeholders. Strong attention to detail, organizational, time management, and process improvement skills; comfort managing competing deadlines, ambiguity, and evolving priorities. A collaborative approach and an understanding of the complexities and nuances of working in a global investment environment. #LI-Hybrid #LI-LR1 What we offer you: Prudential is required by state specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations.
